title: 第040章 是你先招惹我的
slug: 醉酒亲错人年下弟弟失控发疯
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

如果要设想他们两个人之间的爆炸词，那一定是许栀意的名字。

舒楹被酒精麻痹，反应比平时慢半拍，话说出来才意识到自己都说了什么。

而她的对照组谢亭渝依旧是四平八稳的，他给自己倒了杯红酒，拿在手里没喝。

“你想从我这里得到什么答案？”

谢亭渝似乎没把她当成喝醉的人，态度平静，看她的眼神和平常无异。

舒楹很用力地眨了下眼睛，尽量不去看他的脸，“我够累了，你不要总是试探我。”

“那我告诉你，包是王特助选的，跟我无关。”谢亭渝很痛快地给了回答，“还是你觉得我真有闲心去留意他到底准备了什么？”

他砸过来的话太多，她脑瓜子嗡嗡的，只知道他给出的是否定答案。

“那你回一句没有就够了，解释这么多干嘛？”舒楹不过脑地怼了回去，她脑袋乱糟糟的根本顾不上他的心情。

翻涌的情绪比夏天翻脸无情的天气更多变。

她烦得厉害，又去拿起桌上没喝完的酒。

谢亭渝伸手要抢，舒楹急急忙忙地转过身一饮而尽，喝得太急不小心呛了一口。

“擦擦。”谢亭渝皱起眉，很自然地递过来一张抽纸。

舒楹顺手接过，擦了擦放回桌子上。

“其他人呢？”她浑浑噩噩地抬起头，才注意到自己身边空空的，就剩谢亭渝一个在旁边-陪着她。

短剧杀青宴不算什么大事，只是程昱看重这部剧，找了个中档的酒店聚餐。

舒楹刚刚是跟周羡鱼和程昱坐一起的，他俩去其他桌喝酒了，跟她隔了好几个桌。

她这会没什么闲心思考，双手撑着太阳穴，烦躁地看一眼谢亭渝，“许栀意今天没查你岗吗？”

潜台词是你来这里她怎么没跟着。

先前许栀意就跟她说过想来凑热闹，去酒吧都要查岗的人，没道理这时候一言不发。

换做平时舒楹问不出这种话，沾了酒精就什么都顾不上了。

大概她自己都没想到，有一天真的要靠着这点醉意才能说出心里话。

“你比我更关注她。”谢亭渝轻笑一声，从服务员手里拿过柠檬水，给她倒了一杯，“喝点，不然回头难受的又是你。”

说完他自己先愣了，仿佛被某段记忆袭击了一般。

舒楹后知后觉地记起来，是她以前又菜又爱喝，每次出去喝酒，回来都会犯迷糊。

If you want to imagine an explosive word between the two of them, it must be Xu Zhiyi's name.

Shu Ying was numbed by alcohol, and her reaction was half a beat slower than usual. She didn't realize what she had said until she said it.

Her control group, Xie Tingyu, was still calm. He poured himself a glass of red wine and held it in his hand without drinking it.

"What answer do you want from me?"

Xie Tingyu didn't seem to regard her as a drunk person, his attitude was calm, and he looked at her with the same eyes as usual.

Shu Ying blinked hard and tried not to look at his face, "I'm tired, don't keep testing me."

"Then let me tell you, Bao was selected by Assistant Wang and has nothing to do with me." Xie Tingyu answered happily, "Or do you think I really have the time to pay attention to what he has prepared?"

He spoke too much, her head was buzzing, and she only knew that the answer he gave was negative.

"Then it's enough for you to just say no. Why explain so much?" Shu Ying replied without thinking. Her mind was so messed up that she couldn't even care about his mood.

The turbulent emotions are more varied than the unforgiving summer weather.

She was so annoyed that she went to pick up the unfinished wine on the table.

Xie Tingyu stretched out his hand to grab it, but Shu Ying hurriedly turned around and drank it all in one gulp. He drank too quickly and accidentally choked.

"Wipe it." Xie Tingyu frowned and handed over a piece of paper naturally.

Shu Ying took it smoothly, wiped it and put it back on the table.

"Where are the others?" She raised her head in confusion, only to realize that there was nothing around her, except for Xie Tingyu who was there to accompany her.

The ending banquet for the short drama was not a big deal, but Cheng Yu valued the drama and found a mid-range hotel for the dinner.

Shu Ying was sitting with Zhou Xianyu and Cheng Yu just now. They went to drink at other tables, several tables away from her.

She didn't have much time to think at the moment, so she put her hands on her temples and glanced at Xie Tingyu irritably, "Didn't Xu Zhiyi check your post today?"

The subtext is why she didn't follow you when you came here.

Xu Zhiyi had told her before that people who wanted to join in the fun would be checked when they went to the bar, so there was no reason for them to remain silent at this time.

Normally Shu Ying wouldn't be able to ask such questions, but he couldn't care less about anything after getting drunk.

Perhaps she never thought that one day she would really need to be drunk to speak her mind.

"You pay more attention to her than me." Xie Tingyu chuckled, took the lemonade from the waiter, and poured her a glass, "Drink some, or you will be the one who feels uncomfortable later."

After saying that, he was stunned for a moment, as if he was attacked by a certain memory.

Shu Ying later remembered that she used to be a foodie and a drinker, but every time she went out to drink, she would get confused when she came back.
